description.zh:
过滤器名称，可选择一个或者多个名称进行查询。取值范围：

- SkillSpaceId：SkillSpaceId，精确匹配。

- SkillSpaceName：SkillSpace 名称。

- MatchType：匹配类型，控制 SkillSpace 的匹配类型，取值 exact(精确)/prefix(前缀)/fuzzy(模糊)。
description.en:
The filter name. You can specify one or more names for the query. Valid values:

- SkillSpaceId: the SkillSpace ID. Exact match.

- SkillSpaceName: the SkillSpace name.

- MatchType: the match type that controls the matching behavior of SkillSpace. Valid values: exact, prefix, and fuzzy.

description.zh: 过滤器值列表。N的取值范围：1~10。
description.en: The list of filter values. Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

description.zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的行数。每页最大100行，默认为20行。
description.en: The number of entries per page in a paging query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值。
description.en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the value of NextToken that was returned in the previous API call.

descriptions.zh:
### 前提条件
请先确认服务商在创建服务时开启变配功能并完成变配参数设置。
descriptions.en:
### Before you begin
Make sure that the service provider has enabled the specification change feature and completed the specification change parameter settings when creating the service.
